cells.certificate: per-address second moment Sigma_a=sum z z^T; Cell Sigma is sum over owned addresses
cells.form: delta_h = U A z, z = U^T h, U fixed orthonormal
cells.safe_write: Delta A Q = 0 using top-energy eigenspace Q of current Cell covariance

data.identity: pinned dataset/model revision plus per-document and per-token SHA-256 manifest

decision_question: Can bounded dependency-aware subspace state support replay-free continual learning on real pretrained language-model representations without rapid saturation or growth explosion?

evaluation.causal: final per-Cell ablation delta NLL on heldout sequences currently routed to that Cell
evaluation.dependency_causal_relation: diagnostic, not assumed monotonic and not used as a positive gate
evaluation.registered_history: hidden evaluator stores committed sequences and their post-commit NLL; candidate learner never receives them again

interpretation_boundary: A positive result concerns a frozen Pythia representation plus fixed address router and linear writable Cells.
It does not prove arbitrary Transformer weights admit a sufficient low-rank certificate.
It does not solve autonomous semantic router learning or router drift.
It does not reconstruct certificates for an opaque checkpoint that did not accumulate them during its lifetime.
Foundation parameters remain frozen; measured forgetting concerns committed Cell behavior, with heldout domain effects reported separately.

operation: move one fixed address to child
child inherits that address covariance/dependency state
parent covariance drops the moved address
split itself is function-preserving because child A equals parent A
mitosis.v1_limit: an owner with only one address cannot split further; blocked saturation is recorded

router.address_source: mean pooled 64-D frozen projected Pythia hidden state
router.initial_owner_assignment: greedy load-balanced address assignment across base Cells
